import copy, hashlib, json, socket, subprocess, time, uuid
from pathlib import Path
IMAGE = 'nicolaka/netshoot@sha256:47b907d662d139d1e2f22bfe14f4efca1e3f1feed283572f47c970c780c03b61'
owner = 'stackd-ipam-' + uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]
network_id = 'arn:aws:ec2:us-east-1:784561209873:vpc/vpc-' + uuid.uuid4().hex[:17]
spec = {'NetworkID':network_id,'Pool':'10.252.237.0/24','Gateway':'10.252.237.1','Address':'10.252.237.10','MAC':'02:00:00:ec:23:71'}
report = {'owner':owner,'network_id':network_id,'scope':'Two independent native controllers using the same exact VPC identity; live exact-owned Docker TCP receiver; no parent or SSM bridge touched.','observations':{},'cleanup':{}}
controllers = []
def run(args, check=True):
    result = subprocess.run(args, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=40)
    if check and result.returncode: raise RuntimeError(str(args) + ': ' + result.stdout + result.stderr)
    return result

def controller():
    process = subprocess.Popen(['/tmp/stackd-ipam-admission-controller'], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
    controllers.append(process)
    return process

def request(process, value, operation='prepare'):
    process.stdin.write(json.dumps({'Operation':operation,'Spec':value})+'\n'); process.stdin.flush()
    result = json.loads(process.stdout.readline())
    return result

def inspect(name): return json.loads(run(['docker','network','inspect',name]).stdout)[0]
def receive():
    with socket.create_connection((spec['Address'],8080),timeout=2) as connection:
        connection.sendall(b'GET / HTTP/1.0\r\nHost: owned-ipam-proof\r\n\r\n')
        chunks=[]
        while True:
            chunk=connection.recv(4096)
            if not chunk: break
            chunks.append(chunk)
    body=b''.join(chunks).split(b'\r\n\r\n',1)[1].decode()
    assert body == owner, body
    return body

first, second = controller(), controller()
bridge = None
try:
    admitted = request(first,spec)
    assert not admitted['Error'] and admitted['Attached'], admitted
    bridge=admitted['Bridge']
    source = 'from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler,HTTPServer\nclass Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):\n def do_GET(self):\n  body='+repr(owner.encode())+'\n  self.send_response(200);self.end_headers();self.wfile.write(body)\nHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0",8080),Handler).serve_forever()'
    run(['docker','run','-d','--name',owner,'--network',bridge['Name'],'--ip',spec['Address'],'--cap-drop','ALL','--security-opt','no-new-privileges:true','--entrypoint','python3',IMAGE,'-u','-c',source])
    deadline=time.monotonic()+10
    while True:
        try: receive(); break
        except (OSError,AssertionError):
            if time.monotonic() >= deadline: raise
            time.sleep(.05)
    baseline=inspect(bridge['Name'])
    reused=request(second,spec)
    assert reused['Attached'] and not reused['Error'] and reused['Bridge']==bridge, reused
    report['observations']['same_identity_matching_ipam_reused']={'bridge':bridge,'http_body':receive()}
    for label, changes in [('different_pool',{'Pool':'10.252.238.0/24','Gateway':'10.252.238.1','Address':'10.252.238.10'}),('different_prefix',{'Pool':'10.252.237.0/25'}),('different_gateway',{'Gateway':'10.252.237.3'})]:
        candidate=copy.deepcopy(spec);candidate.update(changes)
        rejected=request(second,candidate)
        assert not rejected['Attached'] and 'IPAM differs from requested pool/gateway' in rejected['Error'], rejected
        current=inspect(bridge['Name'])
        for field in ['Id','IPAM','Labels','Options','Containers']:
            assert current[field]==baseline[field], (label,field,current[field],baseline[field])
        report['observations'][label]={'error':rejected['Error'],'attach_callback_reached':rejected['Attached'],'original_native_state_unchanged':True,'http_body':receive()}
    resumed=request(first,spec)
    assert resumed['Attached'] and not resumed['Error'] and resumed['Bridge']==bridge
    report['observations']['matching_reuse_after_rejections']={'http_body':receive(),'ipam':baseline['IPAM']}
finally:
    result=run(['docker','rm','-f',owner],False)
    report['cleanup']['receiver_absent']=run(['docker','inspect',owner],False).returncode!=0
    if bridge:
        result=request(first,spec,'release')
        assert not result['Error'], result
        report['cleanup']['bridge_absent']=run(['docker','network','inspect',bridge['Name']],False).returncode!=0
    for process in controllers:
        process.stdin.close();process.wait(timeout=10)
        assert process.returncode==0, process.stderr.read()
    report['cleanup']['controllers_exited_zero']=True
    Path('/tmp/stackd-ipam-admission-result.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
assert all(report['cleanup'].values())
print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
